decisions.reason: The black-finish range is a surface variant of the firm's core drainage technology, so it uses existing manufacturing know-how and is easy to evaluate, though as a trend-driven line that is only mentioned on the website it carries somewhat more risk.
The shower channel for seamless coverings builds directly on deep drainage expertise and the barrier-free bathroom strategy, and its continued dedicated page signals commitment.
The tileable floor drain is very close to the established offer, fully interpretable with existing know-how, and still presented on its own page.
A stainless steel design grate is a core competence of this metal-fabricating drainage specialist and fits its design-led positioning, so risk is low and results are easy to learn from.

The pump-drain channel is less familiar territory, but it appears to apply what the firm learned from withdrawing Product C through its own R&D, and its dedicated page signals a deliberate second attempt worth giving time.
